decisions.reason: Because the accelerator has stayed on the home page for two years and supports the firm's publicly stated innovation and partnership strategy, management is likely to continue it despite its looser fit and lower sunk cost than plant products.

Although the binder is somewhat less central to the machinery core, the firm has maintained a dedicated page for it and, given its R&D orientation and prior commitment, management is likely to persist at least another year.

This decontamination plant is close to the established business, has been prominently highlighted on the home page in both years with strong launch language, and the firm's investment and visible commitment make withdrawal unlikely in the coming year.
